evidence.summaryExcerpt: Despicable Me (2010): Mac Guff animated the first film. One Wikipedia entry says most of its films are animated by Illumination Studios Paris, a subsidiary formed through the purchase of Mac Guff (which animated the first Despicable Me). The acquisition: Variety reports that the Paris-based outfit splits into two companies: Illumination Mac Guff, now exclusively dedicated to animating Illumination/Universal features; and Mac Guff, which will continue creating vfx. Wikipedia's Illumination article says in 2011, Illumination acquired the animation department of the French animation and visual effects studio Mac Guff. Date discrepancy: Sources differ on timing. One Wikipedia article says the deal happened in mid-2011, while the Hop article gives November 14, 2011.

claimResults.note: Settles checker B's doubt on the clause: Wikipedia says Illumination acquired Mac Guff's animation department in 2011, and Variety reports that the Paris studio split into Illumination Mac Guff and a VFX company that kept the Mac Guff name. So Illumination bought the animation unit, not the whole studio, as the claim says. The sources differ only on the month in 2011, which the claim does not give.

issues.note: Outside the dispute, for the editor: search 18 reports that in Despicable Me (2010) Pierre Coffin voiced most Minions, while Renaud voiced Dave and Clement voiced Jerry. 'Voiced by co-director Pierre Coffin' (c3) is the usual shorthand, since Coffin voices nearly all of them; 'mostly voiced by' would be exact.

editor.reason: Second pass, after tiebreak fc-tbp1t. A pass, B revise, T pass (§9.7). B's revise was its doubt on c4's clause that Illumination later bought Mac Guff's animation unit. T's Tier B search (Wikipedia's Illumination article, Variety) settles it: Illumination acquired Mac Guff's animation department in 2011 and the studio split, so the claim holds as written; sources differ only on the month. T also confirms high-risk c1 (the 2010 debut) with web evidence. T's note that Chris Renaud and Jemaine Clement voiced two Minions in the 2010 film leaves c3 standing as the usual description, since Coffin voices nearly all of them, and both checks confirmed c3 at certain. The acceptance rule passes.
